annotations.title: Edit a Reddit Max template ad

description: Change a Reddit Max template ad: its assets (5 to 45 ACTIVE, at least 3 HEADLINE and 2 IMAGE or VIDEO, read and counted before anything is sent), thumbnails, destination URL, supplementary text, user-generated content enrollment or name. The reply is the template read back, including whether Reddit regenerated the ads. Pausing, activating or archiving it is set_reddit_ads_status.

adAccountId.description: Reddit ad account id (a2_...); omit when only one is shared

displayUrl.description: new display URL; same domain as destinationUrl

thumbnailAssetIds.description: up to 10; an empty list clears them

userGeneratedContent.description: OPT_IN or OPT_OUT of Reddit user-generated content enhancements

name: update_reddit_ads_max_template
